gold_sql:
SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.71559 34.094359)',4326)) AS elevation
FROM public.dem_us
WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.71559 34.094359)',4326))
LIMIT 1;

WITH point_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-117.71559, 34.094359), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_value AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    point_geom p,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326))
)
SELECT elevation FROM raster_value;
